title: 7 Oct-Youth Month Program - Chess Competition
summary: Seventh Day marked the final day of our Youth Month competitions with an exciting Chess Competition, in which 80 students from 12 schools participated with great enthusiasm and concentration.
description:
Seventh Day marked the final day of our Youth Month competitions with an exciting Chess Competition, in which 80 students from 12 schools participated with great enthusiasm and concentration.

Frooti and bananas were distributed to all the participating students.

The Youth Month celebrations will culminate with the Valedictory Function on 15th October at Aryan School, where the winners will receive their prizes and the Nation Builder Awards will be presented by our Chief Guest, District Governor 3141, Rtn. Rajan Dua.

Congratulations to all our Rotarians who participated and gave a wonderful boost to the programme through their presence and encouragement.

A very special congratulations and heartfelt appreciation to our Project Directors, Rtn. Shiv Prasad Khator and Rtn. Navnath Panaskar, for their dedicated efforts in making Youth Month a meaningful and successful celebration.
